\\\ A hand-rolled exploding attack that tracks total damage and the number of
\\\ explosions jointly. The recursion terminates only through the "maximum
\\\ function depth" setting; the truncated call returns an empty list whose
\\\ outcome type is uninhabited, so it sums to the polymorphic additive
\\\ identity and the tuple accumulation stays well-typed.

function: attack DIE:n {
  if DIE = 6 { result: [tuple 6 1] + [attack d6] }
  result: [tuple DIE 0]
}

\\\ Encoding both fields inside one function call keeps the joint
\\\ distribution: damage is at most 54 and explosions at most 9.
function: encode PAIR:n {
  result: [element 1 of PAIR] * 10 + [element 2 of PAIR]
}

ATTACK: [attack d6]
output [encode ATTACK] named "damage and explosions"
output [element 1 of ATTACK] named "damage"
output [element 2 of ATTACK] named "explosions"
